fx.title: Cross-Border FX Provider
fx.text: Choose one or more preferred FX providers to optimize your cross-border payment experience.
info: Transcard provides the opportunity to connect with multiple cross-border payment providers who will enable you to make payments abroad and in other currencies.
You'll need to establish a contractual agreement with the selected FX provider.
You'll need to supply additional information to the FX provider.

existing.title: Link your existing Monex account with your Transcard account
existing.text: If you already have an account please follow these steps:
steps: Please click {here} to link your Monex account to SMART Hub
Monex will update your entity ID to be able to process payments via SMART Hub
Once your account is added to SMART Hub, you'll get an email confirmation from Transcard, and we'll let you know when you can start processing cross-border transactions.

new.title: Begin exploring and setting up an account with Monex
new.text: If you don't have an account, kindly proceed by following these steps:
paragraphs: Visit Monex website for more information on their Cross- border capabilities and ways to sign up.
Once your account has been established with Monex, Transcard will receive confirmation and will complete your cross-border connection.
You will receive an email confirmation from Transcard confirming when you are able to start processing Cross-border payments.
